lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14CrTe crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-6m2 (No. 15), with a 16-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Cr, Mg, and Te centers adopt close-packed-like 12-neighbor environments, with Mg–Mg distances spanning roughly 3.12–3.32 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
